summary: The diff implements all three requirements. REQ-1 is addressed via backend/main.mo (DeliveryInfo type, updated Order type) and backend/migration.mo (migration of old orders). REQ-2 is addressed via DeliveryDetailsModal.tsx and updated ProductDetail.tsx, ProductCard.tsx, and Cart.tsx. REQ-3 is addressed via updated AdminOrders.tsx and OrderDetailModal.tsx with fallbacks for older orders. All acceptance criteria appear to be met, though the Cart.tsx checkout flow uses an expanded inline form rather than the simpler three-field DeliveryDetailsModal, which is a minor deviation but still collects and passes the required fields.

hallucinated_features.description: Phone number validation enforces a 10-digit format (regex check) beyond the spec's requirement of just non-empty validation
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 AC only requires that submitting with any empty field shows a validation error and blocks payment; it does not specify a 10-digit phone number format constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Cart.tsx checkout form collects additional fields beyond Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number: addressLine2, city, state, pincode, and orderNotes
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 specifies the form must collect only Full Name, Delivery Address (multi-line), and Phone Number. The Cart checkout form collects several extra fields not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend/migration.mo module was added for data migration between old and new Order schemas
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 AC mentions providing defaults for existing orders to avoid runtime errors but does not explicitly request a separate migration module file. This is an architectural addition not specified in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: OrderDetailModal and AdminOrders display a Guest badge when the customerId matches the anonymous principal
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement specifies displaying a Guest badge on order cards or modals. This is extra UI functionality not requested.
